summary.headline: Euclid, Comets, and Lunar Diagnosis
summary.text: Astrological excerpts discuss free will versus natural motion, an anecdote by Apomasar about Euclid’s geometric figures, comets as omens of great accidents citing Aristotle and observations above Aphrodite, Zeus, and Kronos, and diagnosis of life periods when the Moon is distant from Ares.
